import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', sep='\t', header=None)

# Extract the first row as column names
column_names = invaded_niche.iloc[0].str.strip('"').str.split('\t').str[0]

# Set the column names
invaded_niche.columns = column_names

# Drop the first row as it contains the column names
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.drop(0)

# Convert relevant columns to numeric types
invaded_niche['n.gard'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['n.gard'], errors='coerce')
invaded_niche['n.total'] = pd.to_numeric(invaded_niche['n.total'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate the proportion of gardening-introduced plants
invaded_niche['prop_gard'] = invaded_niche['n.gard'] / invaded_niche['n.total']

# Drop rows with missing data
invaded_niche = invaded_niche.dropna()

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invaded_niche.head()
